title: What does a doctor, engineer or scientist do?
examples: What kind of school do I need to become a doctor?
Is an engineer just someone who builds things?
What is the hardest part about being a scientist?

explain.say: A doctor helps people when they are sick.

draw.text: What does a doctor, engineer or scientist do?

explain.say: An engineer designs and builds structures and machines.
A scientist explores the world using experiments and research.
A day in the life shows what these professionals do daily.
The training needed for these jobs takes many years of study.
When you see a new bridge, an engineer designed it to be safe.

faq.q: Do I have to be good at science to be an engineer?
faq.a: You need to be good at math and physics for engineering. You might also need to be good at art for design.
asks: What subjects are best for engineering?
Is math the only thing an engineer needs?

faq.q: How long does it take to become a doctor?
faq.a: It takes many years of study after high school to become a doctor. You must pass many exams along the way.
asks: Can I become a doctor quickly?
What is the path to becoming a physician?

faq.q: Do scientists just read books all day?
faq.a: No, scientists do a lot of hands-on work in labs. They test ideas and watch things happen in nature.

faq.q: Can I change careers later in life?
faq.a: Yes, many people change careers when they are adults. You can learn new skills at any age.
asks: Is it too late to change jobs?
Can I switch from one field to another?

faq.q: What is the difference between a scientist and a doctor?
faq.a: A scientist studies how things work in general. A doctor uses that knowledge to treat specific people.
asks: What is the main goal of each job?

facts: Doctors study human bodies to help people stay healthy.
Engineers use math and science to create useful things.
Scientists ask 'why' about how the world works.
All these jobs require learning in school.

quiz.say: If you want to build a new type of bridge, which job is best?
quiz.why: Engineers are trained specifically to design and build structures like bridges.

wrong.0: Artists focus on beauty, while engineers focus on function and safety.
wrong.2: Doctors focus on treating sickness, not building large structures.
wrong.3: Scientists study the science behind bridges, but engineers design them.

quiz.say: Which job involves testing theories about nature?
quiz.why: Scientists use experiments to test their ideas about the natural world.

wrong.0: Engineers apply science to build things that work.
wrong.1: Teachers teach what scientists have already discovered.
wrong.3: Doctors apply science to people, but their main role is treatment.

quiz.say: A person who treats broken bones is most likely a:
quiz.why: Doctors are medical professionals who diagnose and treat injuries and illnesses.

wrong.0: Builder is a general term; doctor is the specific medical title.
wrong.2: An engineer would build a brace, but a doctor treats the bone.
wrong.3: A scientist might study bone growth, but they do not treat the patient.
